app.name: Teren
app.tagline: The site diary that writes itself

unavailable.title: Local storage is not working
unavailable.body: The browser is not allowing local storage. Recording is disabled until that is fixed — nothing recorded earlier has been lost.

update.title: A new version is ready
update.body: Reload whenever it suits you. Nothing is lost — recordings and entries stay on the phone.

install.title: Add Teren to your home screen
install.body: It opens like an app and keeps working where there is no signal.

ios.hint: In Safari, tap the Share button, then choose Add to Home Screen.

today.label: Today's entry
today.missingHint: Record the report before the end of the day.
today.doneHint: You can record another entry if something changes.

recent.label: Recent entries
recent.empty: No entries on this phone for this site yet.

attention.hint: Check what was understood so the report can go out.

reactivate.title: The server is not accepting this phone
reactivate.hint: Your entries are safe. Enter a new code to start sending again.

empty.title: No entries
empty.body: There are no entries for this site yet. Recorded reports are kept here, day by day.

select.title: Choose a day
select.body: Open an entry from the list to see the work, the transcript, the photos and the recording.

partial.offline: No internet — showing only what is on this phone.
partial.unauthorized: This phone is not authorised to read from the server — showing only what is on the phone.
partial.notConfigured: This app has no server set up — showing only what is on the phone.
partial.unavailable: The server is not responding — showing only what is on this phone.
partial.stale: The server is unreachable — this view may not be complete.

detail.label: Entry
detail.immutable: An entry never changes. A correction is filed as a new entry referring back to this one.

unreachable.title: Entry could not be loaded
unreachable.body: This entry is not on this phone, and the server could not be asked whether it has it. Try again when the network is back.

blocked.title: This entry cannot be sent
blocked.body: The server will not accept this entry, so it will not go on its own. The recording and photos are safe on the phone — open the "Waiting to upload" screen to see why.

missing.title: Entry not found
missing.body: This entry is neither on the phone nor on the server. It may have been opened from another link.

awaiting.title: Not on the server yet
awaiting.body: The recording and photos are safe on this phone and upload on their own. Until they arrive, this entry cannot go into a report.

revise.title: You can still correct this entry
revise.body: You have already confirmed this day. Until the report goes out to the client, you can still change what it says.

superseded.title: The report has already gone to the client
superseded.body: This record was changed after the report was handed over for sending, so that change is not in it. This entry can no longer be corrected — a correction is a new entry for that day.

report.title: Report sent to the client
report.body: This is the PDF the client received. Download it to keep it or to pass it on.
report.saved: The report has been downloaded to this device.

error.offline: No internet, so the report could not be fetched. Nothing has happened to it — try again once the network is back.
error.server: The server did not answer, so the report could not be fetched. It has not been lost — try again in a moment.
error.notReady: The report is not ready yet. It is still being produced and sent — try again in a few moments.
error.notReported: No report has gone out for this day yet, so there is nothing to download. It appears here once it has been sent to the client.
error.missing: The server has no such entry. This record may have been opened from an old link.
error.unavailable: The report was sent to the client, but the server can no longer produce the file. The client still has it by email; the entry and its evidence are untouched.
error.rejected: The server refused the request for this report. The entry itself is untouched, but this cannot be fixed from the phone.
error.unauthorized: This phone is not authorised to download reports from the server.
error.notConfigured: This app has no server set up, so reports cannot be downloaded.
error.empty: The server sent an empty file, so nothing was saved. Try again in a moment.
error.unknown: The report could not be downloaded. Nothing has changed on the entry — try again.

empty.title: Nothing was extracted from this recording
empty.body: Processing ran but found no work details in the recording. The transcript and photos below are still the full evidence.

processing.title: Processing
processing.body: The server has the entry and is still extracting work, people and materials. The transcript and photos appear as soon as they are ready.

needsReview.title: Processing failed
needsReview.body: This recording could not be turned into a structured day. Nothing was lost — the recording and photos below are kept, and the entry is waiting for a person to review it.

notSent.title: Not sent yet
notSent.body: Work details are extracted on the server, so until this entry reaches it, all that is here is what was recorded on site.

unavailable.title: Server data unavailable
unavailable.body: The server could not be asked what was extracted from this entry. Below is everything the phone holds.

transcript.pending: The transcript has not arrived from the server yet.
transcript.needsReview: This recording could not be transcribed. The recording itself is kept and can be played back.
transcript.notSent: This entry has not been sent to the server, so there is no transcript.
transcript.unavailable: The server could not be asked for the transcript.

hiddenWork.note: Evidence recorded before it was covered up

photos.onServer: {{count}} more on the server — not on this phone.

audio.offsite: The recording is on the server — not on this phone.

correction.title: A correction is a new record
correction.bodySent: This record has gone to the client and does not change any more. Record a new one for that day; it will be linked to this one.
correction.bodySuperseded: The report went out before this change, so this record can neither be sealed nor sent again. Record a new one for that day; it will be linked to this one.

isCorrection.title: This is a correction
isCorrection.body: This record was made to replace an earlier record of that day, on the same site.

confirm.title: Check the entry
confirm.lead: Nothing is sent to the client until you confirm it.
confirm.draftSaved: Everything you type is kept on this phone, before it is sent.
confirm.draftNotSaved: This phone could not save your corrections. They are still on screen — confirm now so the server keeps them.

awaiting.title: Check what was understood
awaiting.body: This is what the system made of your recording. Correct anything that is wrong — the recording itself is never changed.

noTranscript.title: Nothing could be read from the recording
noTranscript.body: Write down what was done, using your own words below. The recording and the photos are kept exactly as they were.

noStructure.title: The system could not sort this day into lines
noStructure.body: Your own words came through and are above, exactly as recorded. Write the lines yourself below — the recording and the photos are kept exactly as they were.

confirmed.title: Confirmed
confirmed.body: You can still correct this entry until the report goes out.

processing.title: Processing
processing.body: The server has the recording and is still working on it. This screen opens on its own as soon as there is something to check.

notSent.title: Not on the server yet
notSent.body: The recording and photos are safe on this phone and upload on their own. There is nothing to confirm until they arrive.

notFound.title: Entry not found
notFound.body: This entry is neither on the phone nor on the server.

unreachable.title: The server could not be asked
unreachable.body: This entry cannot be confirmed without a connection. Nothing has been lost — try again when the network is back.

reported.title: This entry has already been sent
reported.body: A sent entry never changes. Record a new entry with the correction; it will refer back to this one.

superseded.title: The report has already gone to the client
superseded.body: This record was changed after the report was handed over for sending, so that change is not in it. Confirming again changes nothing — a correction is a new entry for that day.

transcript.hint: Your own words, as recorded. Never changed.

verbatim.title: The system could not sort this day into lines
verbatim.body: Your words came through correctly and are above. Only the sorting into work, materials and people failed. You can send those words as today's record — the client reads them as your own description of the day, not as data the system read out.
verbatim.orEdit: Or write the day out in lines below instead.

confirm.requireContent: Write at least one line before confirming.
confirm.requireContentOrWords: Write at least one line, or send your own words above.

success.title: Entry confirmed
success.body: The report is built from what you confirmed. Your corrections are kept so the system reads the next recording better.

successVerbatim.title: Your own words were confirmed
successVerbatim.body: The report carries your description of the day, exactly as you spoke it — with no lines for work, materials or people, because the system could not read them out of the recording.

error.offline: The server could not be reached, so the entry was not confirmed.
error.server: The server is not responding right now, so the entry was not confirmed.
error.reported: The report for this entry has already been sent, so it can no longer be changed. A correction is a new entry.
error.notReady: The server is still working on this entry. Try again in a moment.
error.rejected: The server did not accept this confirmation.
error.unauthorized: This phone is not authorised to confirm entries.
error.notConfigured: This app has no server set up, so nothing can be confirmed.
error.unknown: Confirming failed for an unexpected reason.

confirm.errorSafe: Nothing was lost — everything you typed is kept on this phone.

correction.title: This is a correction of an earlier record
correction.body: When you confirm, the client gets a new report for that day. The old one stays with him: this corrects it, it does not delete it.

record.tooShort: That recording was too short — try again.
record.saveFailed: The recording could not be saved — please try again.

denied.title: Microphone not allowed
denied.body: Teren cannot record until the browser grants access to the microphone. Allow it in the site settings and try again. Nothing has been lost.

unavailable.title: Microphone unavailable
unavailable.body: The phone reports no microphone, or another app is using it. Close other apps and try again.

unsupported.title: Recording is not supported
unsupported.body: This browser cannot record audio. Open Teren in a newer browser over a secure (HTTPS) address.

error.title: Recording did not start
error.body: Something went wrong starting the microphone. Please try again.

interrupted.title: Recording was interrupted
interrupted.body: Something on the phone took the microphone — a call, or another app. Everything recorded up to that moment is saved.

photos.label: Photos ({{count}})
photos.failed: That photo could not be prepared. Please try again.
photos.rejected: This entry is already queued for upload, so the photo was not added.

saved.title: Entry saved
saved.body: Your phone keeps everything until the server confirms receipt. You can get back to work right away.
saved.missing: That entry is not on this phone.

project.title: No site selected
project.body: Choose a site on the home screen and try again. A recording has to belong to a site.

storage.title: This phone cannot store recordings
storage.body: The browser is not allowing local storage, so a recording would have nowhere to go. Leave private mode or free up space, then try again.

correction.title: We cannot tell which site that day belongs to
correction.body: The record you are correcting is not on this phone and the server could not be reached. A correction has to go to the same site as the record it replaces, so recording will not start until that is known. Try again when you have a signal — nothing has been lost.

correction.resolving: Checking which site that day belongs to…
correction.saved: Once you send it, this record replaces the earlier record of that day.

pending.title: Waiting to upload

offline.title: No internet
offline.body: Entries are safe on your phone and upload automatically when the network returns.

reason.offline: The server could not be reached.
reason.server: The server is not responding right now.
reason.storage: The upload was interrupted before all files arrived.
reason.incomplete: Some files have not arrived on the server yet.
reason.rejected: The server did not accept this entry.
reason.unauthenticated: This phone's access to the server has been withdrawn, or has not been set up yet. The entry is safe and will be sent as soon as access is restored.
reason.unauthorized: This phone is not authorised to send to the server.
reason.notConfigured: This app has no server set up.
reason.insecureContext: Entries can only be sent over a secure (https) address.
reason.unknown: Sending failed for an unexpected reason.

pending.trustNote: Nothing is deleted from your phone until the server confirms the entry was received.

empty.title: Everything is sent
empty.body: The last entry was received today at {{time}}. All recordings and photos are on the server.
empty.bodyNone: No entry is waiting to upload. Recordings and photos you take stay here until they reach the server.

pending.evidenceSafe: The recording and the photos are safe on this phone. Nothing was lost.

welcome.body: Record thirty seconds of speech on site. Teren turns it into a tidy diary and a report for the client.
welcome.joinWithCode: Join a site with a code
welcome.codeHint: You get the join code from the owner of the company.

refused.title: The server is not accepting this phone
refused.body: This phone has been signed out. Nothing was deleted — recordings and entries that have not been sent are waiting on the phone. Enter a new code and sending carries on.

worker.title: On site
worker.body: A foreman joins once with a code and never signs in again. The app opens straight on the record button, with or without signal.

office.title: In the office
office.body: The owner signs in with an email address and a password, and follows every site the company runs.

code.title: Join a site
code.lead: Enter your username and the code you were given. This is done once on this phone.

code.label: JOIN CODE
code.hint: Eight characters from the message. Type it however you like — the app reads O as 0 and fixes the rest.

offline.title: No internet
offline.body: A code can only be checked on the server, so this one screen needs a connection. Your code is not used up by waiting.

resend.action: New phone? Send me a code

sent.title: If that username exists, a code is on its way
sent.body: It goes to the email address on file for you. If you have no address saved, ask your foreman or the owner for a code.

error.offline: There is no internet, so the code could not be checked. The code is not used up — try again when the signal is back.
error.server: The server is not answering just now. The code is not used up — try again in a moment.
error.rejected: That username and code do not go together. Check both and try again — a code lasts seven days and works once, so ask for a new one if this one is old.
error.notAvailable: This server does not offer joining by code yet. The code is not used up — tell the owner of the company.
error.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts from this device. Wait a few minutes and try again.
error.unreadable: The server said yes, but this version of the app could not read the answer. This code may already be used up — ask for a new one and update the app.
error.unknown: Joining did not work, for a reason the app cannot name. The code is not used up — try again.

aside.title: About the join code
aside.source: The owner of the company gives you the code — eight characters, usually in a message.
aside.singleUse: It lasts seven days and works once, for one phone.
aside.thenWhat: After that the app opens straight on the record button. No sign-in, no password, and it works where there is no signal.

login.title: Sign in
login.lead: For the owner of the company and for Teren staff.
login.joinWithCode: Join a site with a code
login.codeHint: You get the code from the owner of the company — on site nobody needs a password.

offline.title: No internet
offline.body: Signing in is checked on the server, so this screen needs a connection.

error.offline: There is no internet, so the sign-in could not be checked. Try again when the signal is back.
error.server: The server is not answering just now. Try again in a moment.
error.notAvailable: This server does not offer signing in with an email address yet.
error.tooManyAttempts: Too many sign-in attempts from this device. Wait a few minutes and try again.
error.unreadable: The server said yes, but this version of the app could not read the answer. Update the app and try again.
error.unknown: Signing in did not work, for a reason the app cannot name. Try again.

aside.title: Who signs in here
aside.body: The owner of the company follows every site, every worker and their join codes.
aside.worker: A foreman on site does not sign in with a password. He joins once with a code.

awaiting.body: Welcome, {{name}}. The Teren staff screens are still being built, so there is nothing to open here yet.

setPassword.title: Choose a passphrase
setPassword.lead: You have been invited to Teren. Choose a passphrase and you can sign in.

aside.title: TWO THINGS WORTH KNOWING
aside.once: This link works once. If it stops working, ask whoever invited you for a new one.
aside.length: At least 12 characters. No rules about capitals, digits or symbols — length is what matters.

offline.title: No internet
offline.body: This needs a connection. Your link is unaffected — try again when you are back online.

noToken.title: This link is not complete
noToken.body: There is no token in the address. Open the link you were sent exactly as it arrived, or ask for a new one.

done.title: Your passphrase is set
done.body: Sign in with {{email}} and the passphrase you just chose.

error.offline: No internet. Nothing was sent, and your link is unaffected.
error.server: The server is not responding right now. Your link is unaffected — try again shortly.
error.rejected: This link no longer works. It may already have been used, replaced, or it may have expired. Ask whoever invited you for a new one.
error.notAvailable: This server has no such page.
error.unreadable: The server answered in a way this app could not read. Nothing was changed.
error.unknown: That did not work, for a reason this app could not identify.
error.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait about five minutes and try again — your link is unaffected.

role.unknown: A role this version of the app does not recognise

username.label: USERNAME
username.hint: This is your name in Teren. It stays yours when the phone changes — on a new phone you type this and a code.

details.label: DETAILS
details.none: There is nothing else on file for this account.

language.label: LANGUAGE
language.hint: The language of the app on this phone. The client's report goes out in the language of the site.

stale.title: Not checked with the server
stale.body: What is shown is what this phone has remembered since it was activated.

unavailable.title: The account could not be loaded
unavailable.body: This phone remembers nothing about the account, so there is nothing to show here. Your recordings are still on the phone.

reason.offline: There is no internet, so nothing could be checked with the server.
reason.unauthorized: The server did not accept this phone, so nothing could be checked. Your recordings stay on the phone and nothing is deleted.
reason.notConfigured: This version of the app has no server set up, so nothing could be checked.
reason.unavailable: The server is not responding, so nothing could be checked.

newPhone.title: A new phone, or a different account
newPhone.body: Enter your username and a code to make this phone yours. Nothing recorded is deleted — entries waiting to be sent stay on the phone.

people.caption: Everybody in the company, by role

notFound.title: That foreman is not in your company
notFound.body: He may have been removed, or the link may belong to another company. Go back to your people and pick him from the list.

unavailable.title: The foreman could not be read

stale.title: Not checked with the server
stale.body: What is shown may not be everything your company has.

reason.offline: There is no internet, so nothing could be checked with the server.
reason.signedOut: The server no longer accepts this sign-in. Sign in again.
reason.forbidden: This account may not do that. Only the owner of the company can manage foremen.
reason.notSignedIn: You are not signed in, so nothing could be read.
reason.refused: The server refused the request. Refresh and try again.
reason.unavailable: The server is not responding just now.

empty.title: No foremen yet
empty.body: Add the first one and hand him his code. It takes a minute.

worker.noEmail: No email address on file, so he cannot ask for a new code himself — he has to ask you.

code.label: JOIN CODE
code.failed: The code could not be read
code.issueFailed: The code could not be made
code.unconfirmed: The server did not answer, so it is not known whether a new code was made. Refresh before making another one — making one stops the old one working.
code.notEmailed: Nothing was emailed. Read the code to him, or send him the message below.
code.copiedMessage: Message copied. Send it to him alone.
code.copyFailed: The app could not use the clipboard. Select the text and copy it by hand.
code.oneAtATime: One man, one message. A code sent into a group chat lets somebody else record the day under his name.
code.disabledHint: He has been removed from the company. Bring him back before making him a code.

none.body: He has no code he could type right now. Make one and send it to him.

reissue.title: Make a new code?
reissue.body: The code above stops working the moment a new one is made. If he already has it and is typing it in, wait.

phones.label: PHONES
phones.none: No phone has been joined to him yet.
phones.unconfirmed: The server did not answer, so it is not known whether the phone was withdrawn. Refresh before trying again.

confirm.title: Withdraw {{phone}} — {{name}}?
confirm.body: From its next contact the server refuses that phone, so the phone signs itself out and the record button goes with it. Nothing on the phone is deleted — everything he has recorded waits there and is sent once he joins again with a new code.

phones.failed: The phones could not be read.

add.body: A name is enough. He gets his code straight away.
add.title: New foreman

email.label: EMAIL ADDRESS (OPTIONAL)
email.hint: With an address he can ask for a new code himself when a phone breaks. Without one, he asks you.

conflict.username: That name was taken while he was being added. Nothing was saved — try again.
conflict.email: That email address is already on a Teren account. Leave it out, or use another one.

add.unconfirmed: The server did not answer, so it is not known whether he was added. Refresh the people before adding him again — adding him twice makes two foremen with the same name.

aside.title: How codes work
aside.body: A code works once and lasts seven days. It is his name plus the code that joins a phone, so send both to that one man — never into a group chat.

signIn.label: You sign in with
signIn.hint: This address, and your password. A new password link is sent here too.

session.label: This browser
session.hint: Sign out at the top of the screen. Nothing recorded is kept here — your foremen’s entries live on their phones.

password.label: Password
password.body: To change it, ask Teren for a new link. The link sets a new password and works once.

stale.body: What is shown is what this browser has remembered since you signed in.

unavailable.title: The account could not be read
unavailable.body: Nothing about your account could be read, and nothing has been changed. Refresh, or sign in again.

about.title: What you can see here
about.body: Every account in the product, and the customers they belong to. Teren staff can see which companies and accounts exist and what is failing — never a transcript, a photograph or a report.

companies.title: Customers
companies.subtitle: Who Teren sells to
companies.caption: Every customer
companies.name: Customer

about.title: What suspending does
about.body: A suspended customer’s phones and sign-ins stop working on their next request — no waiting, no cache. The phones sign themselves out, so his foremen stop recording; nothing on a phone is deleted, but after you resume him every phone has to join again with a new code.

add.title: Add a customer
add.body: A name is all that is needed. Nothing else is created with it — you add his administrator afterwards.

confirm.suspend: Suspend {{name}}? Every phone and sign-in of theirs stops working on the next request. The phones sign themselves out and his foremen stop recording; nothing on a phone is deleted, but after you resume him every phone has to join again with a new code.
confirm.resume: Resume {{name}}? Sign-ins work again straight away. Phones that signed themselves out meanwhile have to join again with a new code — only then is what they recorded sent.

companies.unconfirmed: The server did not answer, so it is not known whether it took effect. Refresh before trying again.

person.title: Account

invite.hint: He has no password yet. We will email him a link to choose one.

reset.hint: He already has a password. A new link lets whoever opens it choose another and sign in as him — so it goes only to his own address.

worker.hint: A foreman never has a password. He joins a phone with his username and a code from his own company’s admin.

person.unconfirmed: The server did not answer, so it is not known whether it took effect. Refresh before trying again.

missing.title: No such account
missing.body: It may have been removed, or the address you followed may be wrong.

add.title: Add a person
add.unconfirmed: The server did not answer, so it is not known whether the account was created. Refresh before trying again.

body.companyAdmin: He administers one customer: his foremen, their codes and their phones.
body.staff: Teren staff see every account and every customer. They can never read a customer’s diary.

email.label: EMAIL
email.hint: This is how he signs in, and the only way to reset him later.

company.label: CUSTOMER
company.none: No customers yet. Add one first.
company.unreadable: The customers could not be loaded, so this list is empty. Refresh and try again.

add.emailed: We sent the link that lets him choose a password to {{email}}.
add.notEmailed: No mail relay is configured, so nothing was sent. The account exists and cannot be used until an invite reaches him.

reason.offline: No internet. Nothing reached the server.
reason.signedOut: Your sign-in has expired. Sign in again.
reason.forbidden: Your role may not do this.
reason.refused: The server did not accept this.
reason.emailTaken: That address already has an account. Invite that account instead of making a second one.
reason.unavailable: The server is not responding right now.

health.title: System health
health.subtitle: What the pipeline is doing across every customer
health.at: As the server saw it at {{at}}
health.unavailable: Nothing was read, so there are no numbers to show. Try again.

about.title: What you can see here
about.body: Every number on this screen is the server's, counted at the one moment named under the title — nothing here is live, and a refresh is the only thing that moves it. The two failure lists overlap on purpose: a delivery failure is written onto the entry as well, so one problem can legitimately appear in both. Never add them together. This screen counts days, reports and failures; it holds no transcript, no photograph and no report.

failures.delivery: Why reports did not go out
failures.overlap: A delivery failure is written onto the entry too, so a reason can appear in both lists. These are two views of what is wrong, not two halves of it — do not add them up.

delivery.title: Reports
delivery.custody: Sent means the mail server took custody of the report — never that anybody read it.

queue.title: Job queue
queue.unknownTitle: The queue could not be read
queue.notConfigured: This server runs no jobs, so there is nothing to read — and nothing anywhere is being transcribed, structured or sent. The numbers below are unknown, not zero.
queue.unreadable: The queue exists but did not answer. The numbers below are unknown, not zero.
queue.unknown: The server did not say why. The numbers below are unknown, not zero.

noServers.title: Nobody is emptying the queue
noServers.body: The queue answered and no worker is running. Every request still succeeds while nothing is being transcribed, structured or sent — the one failure that looks perfectly healthy from every other screen in the product.

sites.caption: Every site, the ones needing attention first

omitted.title: Showing {{shown}} of {{total}} sites
omitted.body: The server sends at most 500 sites and puts the ones needing attention first, so everything left out is a site with nothing wrong. Every number above still counts the whole estate.

reason.noEvidence: No evidence — neither a recording nor a photograph

reason.extractionInvalid: The extracted day could not be used
reason.noRecipients: The client has no address for the report
reason.recipientsUnusable: The client's address cannot be used
reason.deliveryNotConfigured: Sending mail is not set up

reason.photoMissing: A photograph is not in storage
reason.renderTimeout: Building the report took too long
reason.renderFailed: The report could not be built
reason.timeZoneUnknown: The site's time zone is not known
reason.deliveryRejected: The mail server refused the report
reason.deliveryUnauthorized: The mail server refused our sign-in

reason.supersededAfterSend: The record changed after its report had gone out

logs.title: Log
logs.subtitle: What the product did
logs.caption: Every line the server wrote and every action the app recorded
logs.unavailable: Nothing was loaded — the server did not answer this question.

about.title: What you are looking at
about.body: The server’s own log and the actions people took in the app, newest first. The filtering happens on the server, so this screen never knows a total — only how many lines it has loaded so far. When the server is holding more, “Load more” waits at the foot. The download button gives you the same filters as a CSV file.

export.failed: The download did not go through

triage.label: Status — tap to see only that
